teacher_notes_ar: القاعدة الذهبية — صفر مجهود: لا تطلب من الطفل أن يكرر، لا تقل له 'قل' أو 'جرب' أو 'قول معايا'. أنت تتكلم وتعمل، وهو يكتسب. الكلام سيخرج من وحده حين يجهز، تمامًا كما خرجت لغته الأولى.

انطق ببطء مع الإيماءة: «I stand up.» — كررها ثلاث مرات قبل الانتقال لأي جملة جديدة. الهدف أن تسمع أذنه نفس النمط حتى يتنبأ به.
عنصر اليوم الجديد (15%): stand up / sit down. قدّمه وحده أولًا مرتين، ثم ادمجه في الجمل. لا تقدم أكثر من عنصر جديد واحد في الجلسة.
بعد سؤال «Stand up, please.» اصمت وانظر بترقّب. بعد كل جملة اصمت 3–5 ثوانٍ وانظر في عينيه. أي حركة أو صوت منه = تفاعل ناجح، كافئه بابتسامة وتكرار الجملة.
ممنوع الترجمة نهائيًا: اربط الكلمة بالشيء والفعل والتجربة نفسها أمام عينيه. الصورة والصوت واللمس هي القاموس.

scene.setting: A hand touching a hot radiator and pulling back; another hand touching a cold window.
scene.characters: The Teacher (caregiver) and the Child. One real location, real objects.
scene.props: Everything the scene names must be physically present.

beats.camera: Close on teacher's face, then tilt to include the child. Warm eye contact.

audio.line: Hello hello! Look, look! It's time.

beats.sfx: Soft, cheerful. Same intro jingle each episode.

audio.line: The fire is hot.  ·  The fire is hot.  ·  The fire is hot.

beats.sfx: Real ambient sounds of the scene (traffic, kettle, market).

beats.camera: Tight on teacher's expectant face during the pause — warm, patient, zero pressure.
beats.action: Teacher asks, then holds a real 5-second silence with bright eyes and raised eyebrows. Whether the child answers or not, the teacher then completes the answer himself, warmly, as if the child had asked him to. Any sound the child makes is celebrated but never requested.

audio.who: (silence — the child may or may not attempt; both are perfect)

beats.sfx: A tiny 'sparkle' cue only if the child initiates anything.

beats.camera: Floor-level wide: both bodies moving in the scene.
beats.action: Teacher acts out every line physically (picks up, pours, points, walks, mimes) and gently guides the child's hands through the same action. Language rides on movement.
beats.sfx: Real object sounds (cup set down, door, water).

beats.beat: Variation & free play (child leads, teacher expands)
beats.camera: Handheld, playful. When the child initiates anything, the camera follows HIM.
beats.action: Teacher changes one variable (color, size, person) and re-uses today's lines. If the child produces a word or fragment, the teacher expands it into the full sentence with visible joy — and never asks him to repeat the expanded version.
beats.sfx: Natural room tone.

beats.beat: Spiral recall — yesterday's lines inside today's world
beats.camera: Same framing as the immersion beat; inserts of the earlier episode allowed.
beats.action: Teacher weaves lines the child already owns into today's scene, casually, as if remembering them together. Zero testing — pure recognition pleasure.
beats.sfx: Gentle 'remember this?' musical tag.

beats.camera: Slow push-in. Soft light if possible.
beats.action: Teacher repeats today's first line once, very softly, while both settle down. The line now belongs to the calm.
beats.sfx: Ambient only, quieter.

beats.camera: Return to the opening framing. Slow, calm.
beats.action: Same goodbye words and same gesture every time, then a quiet moment together.

audio.line: That's all for today. Bye bye, see you next time!

beats.sfx: Same outro jingle each episode.
